statements.status_notes: CVE-2023-50570 involves a denial of service triggered by crafted IP address strings causing unbounded processing. Cassandra only processes IP addresses from trusted cluster configuration (cassandra.yaml seed nodes, gossip peers) and does not accept arbitrary IP address strings from untrusted user input.
